_comment: Advanced config. Every option is shown with its default value; include only the keys you want to change. Most of these can also be set with SHELDON_* environment variables (see mcp-bridge/.env.example). For 'model', use the exact id your provider lists.
_comment_tiers: Each tool already belongs to a built-in tier: 25 player tools and 5 admin tools (spawn_dino_at_player, set_time, give_item, execute_console_command, broadcast). A player is assigned the admin tier automatically when they are a server admin (in AllowedCheaterPlayerIDs). You do NOT need to list tools to get the defaults. Use the 'tiers' block only to customize per-tier rate limits, add parameter limits, grant extra tools (glob patterns, additive on top of the built-ins), or define your own tiers. 'inherits' pulls in everything from a parent tier.
